status: HOLD: dedicated rail improves static margin; layout, input headroom and transients unqualified
sources: reference/tps62130.pdf sections7.5,8.3.3,9.2; same TPS62130 family pinout as fixed variant
module_peak_basis: Datasheet gives1A at3.3V. Reusing1A at3.584V is a design screen, not a guaranteed operating current at the new voltage.
startup: U26 PG pulled to its own output enables system U17; nominal PG threshold92-98% of setpoint. PG is high impedance in shutdown/UVLO/thermal fault, so retained charge and fault sequencing remain open.
remaining_holds: PWM accuracy condition VIN>=VOUT+1V may not hold at low USB input after two eFuses. Characterize dropout/headroom; no guaranteed USB compatibility claimed.

Feedback resistor initial tolerance and independent 100ppm/K drift over100K included. Aging, line/load regulation, hot ferrite DCR, PCB IR drop and ripple excluded; this is not a product operating-temperature rating.
PFM bound is not a guaranteed1A operating point; transition/load-step behavior must be measured.
L2201 saturation rating vs fault current, effective MLCC capacitance and ferrite/dual-cap resonance need qualification.
AP6256 requires VBAT before/coincident with VDDIO; verify cold start, rapid cycling, thermal shutdown and power removal.
Full simultaneous USB load and expansion power allocation remain open.
